macros.name: defglyphclass
macros.doc: A new glyph class can be defined using one of the commands \defglyphclass, \newglyphclass, \renewglyphclass, and \provideglyphclass.

macros.name: getclassofglyph
macros.doc: Return the name of the glyph class, that contains the argument.

macros.name: ifglyphinclass
macros.doc: Tests if the glyph ⟨glyph⟩ is contained in the glyph class ⟨side⟩/⟨name⟩.

macros.name: mtxcomment
macros.doc: Using the \mtxcomment{⟨comment⟩} command, you can write the given argument as comment into the mtx file.

macros.name: newglyphclass
macros.doc: The macro \newglyphclass works as \defglyphclass but defines a new glyph class. It produces an error if the class already exists.

macros.name: printglyph
macros.doc: Print the glyph with the given PostScript name or slot number (in decimals, octal, or hexadecimals; as usual in LaTeX).

macros.name: provideglyphclass
macros.doc: The macro \provideglyphclass works as \newglyphclass but does only do its job if the glyph class does not exist right now.

macros.name: renewglyphclass
macros.doc: The macro \renewglyphclass works as \newglyphclass but redefines an existing one.

macros.name: saveslotnumber
macros.doc: Saves the slot number of a glyph given as second argument (by PostScript name or its slot number in decimals, octal, or hexadecimals) in the counter specified in the first argument.

envs.name: kerntable
envs.doc: The kerning table is generated by the kerntable environment which is represented by a longtable environment internally.
